nodes.question: How are plastics like polyester and nylon recycled to make clothes?
nodes.answer: Plastics like polyester and nylon, often sourced from drink bottles, are recycled through grinding, melting, and extrusion into new fibres, reducing the amount of plastic waste that ends up in landfills.
